I wonder how long the job of Programmer will persist?
We are close to the point where all coding will be done by AI.
Remember, at the start, programming was by writing the numbers for operations and operand addresses.
That low level form of the task disappeared when assemblers were written.
Then we used names for variables, operations and subroutines, and sugar-coated conditionals and loops…
Currently, we specify what we want the code to do in English, and programmers plan, structure, and write the code.
We can now cut the human out completely.
